item.title: Brazil scraps tax on small parcels as Chinese platforms lose US and EU access
item.description: Brazil on Wednesday eliminated its federal import tax on small overseas parcels, moving in the opposite direction from US and European Union efforts to close a loophole that saw such Chinese retail giants as Shein and Temu expand rapidly. The elimination will hurt the country’s tax base, but the levy on lower value shirts, electronics, toys and kitchen gadgets ultimately proved too unpopular among Brazilians ahead of the October 4 presidential election, forcing Brasilia to back down. In an... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Former child refugee selected as Labour candidate in byelection for Starmer’s old seat
item.description: Sagal Abdi-Wali, who came from Somalia in 1990s, will likely face Zack Polanski in Holborn and St Pancras contest A former child refugee who became the leader of Camden council has been selected to be the Labour candidate for the byelection in Holborn and St Pancras. Sagal Abdi-Wali, who came to the UK from Somalia as a child in the 1990s and was elected leader of Camden council in May, was chosen to represent Labour members in the north London seat vacated by Keir Starmer. She was previously the chair of the local constituency Labour party, after first being elected as a Labour councillor in… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.description: Donald Trump ha decidido dedicar las horas previas al 25º aniversario de los atentados del 11 de septiembre a la campaña para las elecciones legislativas de noviembre. El presidente viajó este miércoles a Dallas para encabezar la primera convención de medio mandato organizada en la historia del Partido Republicano, un encuentro de dos días concebido para movilizar a sus votantes y presentar bajo una misma marca política a los candidatos y las propuestas con las que el partido pretende conservar el control del Capitolio. item.title: Sigue en directo el funeral de Estado del Rey Harald de Noruega
item.description: Este miércoles tiene lugar el funeral de Harald V , fallecido el pasado 28 de agosto a los 89 años . Los ciudadanos y la familia real de Noruega se preparan para un programa oficial que durará cerca de tres horas y contará con la presencia de miembros de casas reales y de jefes de Estado de decenas de países. La ciudad, Oslo , contará con grandes dispositivos de seguridad para mantener el orden y el protocolo de Estado. La ceremonia será en la catedral luterana de Oslo. El príncipe británico Guillermo, los Reyes españoles Felipe VI y Letizia, los presidentes de Ucrania, Finlandia, Alemania y… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Hong Kong, Kazakhstan sign MOU on transport lab, discuss low-altitude economy
item.description: Kazakhstan has signed a memorandum of understanding with Hong Kong’s transport authorities to establish a laboratory and discussed low-altitude economy initiatives to help manage traffic jams.
